purpose: Evaluate four selected existing reinvest checkpoints on a broad fast/no-AoA surface before any new training or official full evaluation.

avg43022_90_100.reference_role: Arithmetic weight average of seed43022 chck_90M and chck_100M; tests whether 90M Supplement/EWoK gains can retain 100M GlobalPIQA/Entity balance.

avg43122_80_100.reference_role: Arithmetic weight average of seed43122 chck_80M and chck_100M; tests whether 80M Supplement/GPIQA gains can retain 100M broad balance.
